overall_assessment: Section extraction for NIH works very well on all 20 random controls: the fixed heading set (Kort om emnet, Forkrav, Læringsutbytte, Læringsformer og aktiviteter, Arbeidskrav, Vurdering/eksamen, Kjernelitteratur) maps correctly, Arbeidskrav stay in coursework_requirements, admission text (Hvem kan ta dette emnet?) and 'Reduksjon i studiepoeng' tables are dropped, and placeholder reading lists are not emitted. The only defect is a small amount of attendance-requirement text left in assessment in two courses.

findings.evidence:
Oppmøtekrav. Bestått/ ikke bestått.
100% deltakelse på døgnkontinuerlig undervisning, og 80% deltakelse på all annen timeplansfestet undervisning.
findings.description: Attendance requirements (oppmøtekrav / 100 % frammøte) are pass/approve gates and belong in coursework_requirements by the codebook, but in courses where they sit under the Vurdering/eksamen heading (or where there is no Arbeidskrav heading) they stay in assessment. FRI304 has an Arbeidskrav section, yet its oppmøtekrav ends up in assessment; PPU405 has no Arbeidskrav heading and its '100 % frammøte i praksisperiode.' is in assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sections are cut strictly by heading; NIH authors sometimes write attendance requirements as the last lines under Vurdering/eksamen, and no content-based rule moves them.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional: in .clean_sections() move lines starting with 'Oppmøtekrav' or matching '^\d+ ?% (frammøte|oppmøte|deltakelse)' from assessment to coursework_requirements for nih. Low priority given rarity.
